units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:8">Keth. V, 8</cite> <he>מתכסה בבְלָאוֹתֵיהֶן וכ׳</he> she wears her winter clothes in their outworn condition in the summer.

Ib. 65ᵇ מותר ב׳ the entirely outworn clothes (= שחקים Mish. l. c.); a. fr.—2) the woman’s right to claim compensation for the wear or ruin of the things which she brought along as her property (v. מלוג, a. צאן ברזל).
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 10:1">Yeb. X, 1</cite> <he>ולא ב׳ …</he> nor can she claim compensation for used or spent property (but may take the things in what condition they are, v. comment.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 11:6">Keth. XI, 6</cite>.—[Y. ib. V, 30ᵇ bot.; XI, 34ᵃ bot., as in Mish.
